semantic_groups.use_in_experiment: Use these groups for stratified error analysis and per-group reporting. They are not train/dev/test splits and do not create gold truth by themselves.
limitations: Grouping is based on deterministic headline heuristics, not domain-expert taxonomy.
Small groups should be merged or reported descriptively if confidence intervals are unstable.
Ontology candidate classes and operational semantic groups intentionally differ for status/cancellation/FYI notices.

methodology_remediation.scope_statement: The current scored run is a narrow FAA ATCSCC advisory / NASA ATMONTO ATCSCC schema-slice experiment. PDF reference documents are added only as a second source-family design for the next rerun; PDF definition/procedure metrics must not be mixed into the ATCSCC event F1 table.

source_families.preferred_system_design: S0 deterministic backbone plus S3 semantic enrichment and validator gate

source_families.task: definition, terminology, procedure, and source-mapping evidence extraction

methodology_remediation.cross_source_metric_policy: Compare structural conformance, evidence grounding, and canonicalization yield across source families. Report semantic F1 within each task family only.

consensus_sota_remediation.scope_boundary: These constraints refine the narrow ATCSCC / ATMONTO rerun. They are not a pivot to a general aviation KG or an end-to-end GraphRAG claim.

s1_interpretation.rule: Report raw S1 coverage, JSON adherence, and evidence containment only. Compute target-schema precision/recall/F1 only after canonicalization.

rejection_adjudication.boundary: This artifact finalizes property-level error categories for the 288 pilot rejections. It does not automatically approve profile extensions or convert validator-rejected facts into semantic gold facts.

claim_statuses.label: Runtime NASA ATMONTO profile feasibility
claim_statuses.rationale: The pilot generated the schema catalog, ATCSCC schema slice, and validated candidate-fact artifact. This remains a schema-engineering claim.

claim_statuses.label: Schema-slice constraint benefit
claim_statuses.rationale: S2 schema guidance reduces target-schema violation rate versus the canonicalized S1b baseline by at least 10 percentage points.

claim_statuses.label: Validator/repair benefit
claim_statuses.rationale: S3 meets the repair-success threshold and preserves semantic correctness.

claim_statuses.label: Rejection analysis utility
claim_statuses.rationale: All 288 rejections have final property-level action labels: {"extractor_bug": 13, "profile_gap": 275}.

hypothesis_statuses.label: Schema guidance reduces structural drift
hypothesis_statuses.rationale: S2 schema guidance reduces target-schema violation rate versus the canonicalized S1b baseline by at least 10 percentage points.
hypothesis_statuses.falsification_criterion: Falsified if schema guidance does not reduce unsupported target-schema terms after a canonicalized S1b baseline exists, or if the reduction only comes from suppressing more than 25 percent of gold-supported facts.

hypothesis_statuses.label: Validator/repair improves valid yield
hypothesis_statuses.rationale: S3 meets the repair-success threshold and preserves semantic correctness.
hypothesis_statuses.falsification_criterion: Falsified if S3 repair success is below 15 percent of initially invalid facts, or if S3 manual semantic correctness is more than 5 percentage points lower than S2.

hypothesis_statuses.label: Hybrid backbone plus enrichment improves selected semantic predicates
hypothesis_statuses.rationale: S4 improves the selected semantic predicate macro-F1 over S0 while preserving deterministic-field macro-F1 within tolerance.
hypothesis_statuses.falsification_criterion: Falsified if S4 hybrid does not improve selected semantic predicate F1 over S0 while preserving deterministic-field F1 within the pre-registered tolerance.

hypothesis_statuses.label: Rejection triage produces actionable engineering decisions
hypothesis_statuses.rationale: All 288 rejections have final property-level action labels: {"extractor_bug": 13, "profile_gap": 275}.
hypothesis_statuses.falsification_criterion: Falsified if more than 20 percent of rejected facts remain manual-review-only after review, or if profile extensions cannot be tied to source evidence and NASA ATMONTO terms.

requirements.requirement: Position the current NASA ATMONTO loop as pilot / feasibility evidence, not a completed formal experiment.
requirements.evidence: EXPERIMENTS.md contains pilot/feasibility boundary and bronze-until-reviewed language.

requirements.requirement: Sample 80-120 ATCSCC advisories for the formal gold set.
Freeze reviewed gold annotations before semantic scoring.
Define the corrected system suite: S0, diagnostic S1, S1b, S2, S3, and S4.
Run all corrected-stage systems on the identical sampled records.
requirements.evidence: {"S0_rule_only": true, "S1_llm_only": true, "S1b_llm_canonicalized": true, "S2_llm_schema_slice": true, "S3_llm_schema_slice_validator_repair": true, "S4_hybrid_backbone_enrichment": true}

requirements.requirement: Define JSON, schema, semantic, repair, and manual-correctness metrics.
Report JSON adherence, schema violation rate, precision/recall/F1, repair success, and manual semantic correctness.
Account for all pilot rejections in property-level error analysis.
Finalize whether each rejection group is extractor bug, NASA ATMONTO profile gap, source ambiguity, or manual-review-only.
Assign supported, falsified, or inconclusive status to claims C1-C4 and hypotheses H1-H4.
Fix the protocol artifact with claims, hypotheses, baselines, metrics, and falsification criteria.

completion_audit.claim_boundary: A satisfied audit means the formal experiment can be reported; pending items must remain described as pilot/prepared-state evidence.

claim_boundary: Formal metrics are descriptive until all four systems have predictions and the frozen reviewed gold set is available.
